etymologies.etymologyHTML: From dispose +‎ -al.

definitions.definition: (countable) A disposition; an arrangement, categorization, or classification of things.
(countable, Australian rules football) A kick or a handball of the ball during a game.

quote.citation: 2019 In the mix: Who's pushing for selection for round eight? Australian Football League, 7 May 2019. Accessed 8 May 2019.
quote.text: Lewy Taylor was quiet against the Swans with just seven disposals but hit the mark with a couple of kicks inside 50 during the crucial last quarter.

definitions.definition: (countable) A disposing of or getting rid of something.
(uncountable) The power to use something or someone.

quote.citation: 1978 April 8, “Boston So. End (classified advertisement)”, in Gay Community News, page 14:
quote.text: 2 bedroom apt nicely done. Dishwasher, disposal and many closets. Heat incl $290 mo + security.
